Lag a vector within a panel, respecting gaps in the year sequence

Source: R/add_lag.R
lag_with_year_gap_check.Rd

Lag a vector within a panel, respecting gaps in the year sequence

Usage

lag_with_year_gap_check(x, year, n)

Arguments

x

Vector to lag.

year

Integer year vector, same length as x, for the same cross-sectional unit and already sorted ascending.

n

Integer. Number of years to lag by.

Value

x shifted back by n positions, with NA wherever the corresponding row is not exactly n years earlier (e.g. because that year is missing from the data).
